symptom: published OData `expose (Name as 'Name' (KEY), "Description")` stored the member name with its double quotes; check and exec were clean, describe printed `"Description" as '"Description"'`, mx check reported CE1613 "The selected attribute 'ModA.EntA."Description"' no longer exists" (mendixlabs/mxcli#1423). Published microflow parameters had the same defect
cause: parseExposeMembers and the publish-microflow expose loop took `member.IdentifierOrKeyword().GetText()`, which keeps a QUOTED_IDENTIFIER's quotes; every other identifierOrKeyword slot in the file already used identifierOrKeywordText
insight: **`identifierOrKeyword().GetText()` is the raw token — quotes included.** Any name slot reading it bypasses the quoting the skills recommend, and nothing downstream notices because the quoted string is still a valid-looking name until mx resolves it. `grep -n 'IdentifierOrKeyword().GetText()' mdl/visitor` is the audit; the remaining hits are enum/keyword values or already wrapped in unquoteIdentifier. Describe round-trip is the cheapest repro: the stored quotes reappear inside the `as '...'` exposed name
